A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Simple answers.

Let’s clear a few things up.

See all FAQs
What is Hello Customer?

Hello Customer is a customer engagement and marketing platform by SaralKaro for Indian businesses. It brings customer contacts, promotional campaigns and supported WhatsApp Business communication into one mobile-focused experience. AI-assisted creation is planned and not yet available.

Is the app available yet?

Hello Customer is currently under development. Product previews are illustrative concepts, and early-access enquiries do not create an account or begin a free trial.

Can I use my existing WhatsApp Business number?

This depends on supported connection methods and Meta eligibility requirements. Account eligibility, verification, template approval and messaging limits are determined by applicable Meta requirements.

How much does Hello Customer cost?

Hello Customer offers one software subscription priced at ₹399 per month.

Are WhatsApp messaging charges included?

No. Applicable WhatsApp messaging charges are separate from the Hello Customer software subscription and depend on Meta’s applicable pricing and usage.
